test_cases.input: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Can you refund the extra charge?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a duplicate subscription charge and requests a refund.
test_cases.notes: Clean, unambiguous billing case.

test_cases.input: My invoice for August shows a $15 charge I don't recognize. What is this for?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is questioning an unrecognized $15 charge on their August invoice.

test_cases.input: Can I switch from monthly to annual billing? Will I get a discount?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to switch to annual billing and is asking about a discount.

test_cases.input: I cancelled my plan last week but was still billed. Please refund immediately.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer was billed after cancelling their plan and wants a refund.

test_cases.input: Do you offer a student discount? I'm currently enrolled full-time.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether a student discount is available.

test_cases.input: Why did my card get declined during checkout even though it has funds?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's card was declined at checkout despite having available funds.
test_cases.notes: Could brush against technical, but root issue is payment processing.

test_cases.input: I need an itemized receipt for my company's expense report, covering the last 3 months.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer requests an itemized receipt for the last 3 months for expense reporting.

test_cases.input: My currency shows USD but I was actually charged in EUR at checkout, and the converted amount seems off.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged in EUR instead of the displayed USD and believes the conversion is incorrect.
test_cases.notes: Multi-currency billing edge case, tests numeric precision in summary.

test_cases.input: refund pls charged wrong amount 2x!!
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer says they were charged twice the correct amount and wants a refund.
test_cases.notes: Extremely short, informal, shorthand — tests robustness to low-effort input.

test_cases.input: I'd like to downgrade my plan but keep my current billing cycle end date, is that possible?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to downgrade their plan while keeping the same billing cycle end date.

test_cases.input: The app crashes every time I try to upload a photo larger than 5MB.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's app crashes when uploading photos over 5MB.

test_cases.input: I can't log in — it keeps saying 'invalid credentials' even though my password is correct.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in despite entering the correct password; sees an invalid credentials error.
test_cases.notes: Could be labeled 'account' too — see tc_030 for the deliberately ambiguous twin of this case.

test_cases.input: The dashboard is showing a blank white screen after the latest update.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer sees a blank white screen on the dashboard after the latest update.

test_cases.input: Export to CSV is not working, the downloaded file is empty.
test_cases.expected_summary: The CSV export feature produces an empty downloaded file.

test_cases.input: Push notifications stopped working after I updated to the latest iOS version.
test_cases.expected_summary: Push notifications stopped working after an iOS update.

test_cases.input: The API is returning a 500 error on every POST request to /v1/orders since this morning.
test_cases.expected_summary: The API returns a 500 error on all POST requests to /v1/orders since this morning.
test_cases.notes: Technical/developer-facing language, tests domain vocabulary handling.

test_cases.input: Search results are loading extremely slowly, sometimes taking over 30 seconds.
test_cases.expected_summary: Search results are taking over 30 seconds to load.

test_cases.input: I integrated your webhook but it's not firing when an order status changes.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's webhook integration is not firing on order status changes.

test_cases.input: app broken again. 3rd time this week. fix it
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the app is broken again for the third time this week and wants it fixed.
test_cases.notes: Short, frustrated tone, no specific bug detail — tests handling of vague reports.

test_cases.input: The dark mode toggle resets to light mode every time I close and reopen the app.
test_cases.expected_summary: The dark mode setting resets to light mode whenever the app is closed and reopened.

test_cases.input: My account got locked after I tried logging in from a new phone. Please help me get back in.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's account is locked after logging in from a new device and needs help regaining access.

test_cases.input: How do I change the email address linked to my account?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to know how to change the email address linked to their account.

test_cases.input: I want to permanently delete my account and all associated data.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer requests permanent deletion of their account and all associated data.

test_cases.input: Can I merge two accounts I accidentally created with different emails?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to merge two accounts created under different email addresses.

test_cases.input: I forgot my password and the reset link in the email isn't working.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's password reset link is not working after forgetting their password.

test_cases.input: Please add my colleague as an admin on our team workspace.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to add a colleague as an admin to their team workspace.

test_cases.input: I'm getting a 'too many login attempts' lockout even though I only tried once.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out with a 'too many login attempts' error despite only one login attempt.
test_cases.notes: Overlaps with technical (a bug) but core need is account access restoration.

test_cases.input: How do I enable two-factor authentication on my account?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to know how to enable two-factor authentication.

test_cases.input: Someone else seems to have logged into my account, I see activity I didn't do.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer suspects unauthorized access to their account based on unfamiliar activity.
test_cases.notes: Security-sensitive — model should not downplay urgency in the summary.

test_cases.input: I can't log in and I'm not sure if it's because I forgot my password or my account got suspended.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in and is unsure whether it's a forgotten password or a suspended account.
test_cases.notes: Deliberately ambiguous twin of tc_012 — could be technical (login bug) or account (access issue). Labeled account because the customer's own framing centers on account status.

test_cases.input: What are your business hours for phone support?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about phone support business hours.

test_cases.input: Do you have an affiliate or referral program I can join?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether an affiliate or referral program exists.

test_cases.input: I wanted to say your support team was incredibly helpful yesterday, thank you!
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is thanking the support team for helpful assistance received yesterday.
test_cases.notes: Positive, non-actionable feedback — tests that the model doesn't force it into a problem category.

test_cases.input: Is there a public roadmap I can check to see what features are coming next?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking if a public product roadmap exists.

test_cases.input: Can you connect me with your partnerships team? I'd like to explore a collaboration.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to be connected with the partnerships team to discuss a collaboration.

test_cases.input: Do you have a mobile app, or is this web-only?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether a mobile app is available or the product is web-only.

test_cases.input: hey
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer sent a greeting with no further content or request.
test_cases.notes: No actionable content at all — tests graceful handling of near-empty input.

test_cases.input: Oh great, ANOTHER outage. Really loving the 99.9% uptime you all promised.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is sarcastically complaining about a service outage despite the promised uptime.
test_cases.notes: Sarcasm test — underlying issue is technical (outage), tone should not be taken literally as a compliment.

test_cases.input: wow amazing, billed me AGAIN for a plan I cancelled in March. love this company.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically reports being billed again for a plan cancelled in March.
test_cases.notes: Sarcasm test in a billing context — model must not classify as 'general' positive feedback.

test_cases.input: no puedo iniciar sesion, dice que mi contraseña es incorrecta pero estoy seguro que es correcta
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer (writing in Spanish) cannot log in because the password is reported as incorrect despite being sure it is correct.
test_cases.notes: Mixed-language input (Spanish) — tests whether the model still classifies and summarizes correctly, ideally summarizing in English for the support team.

test_cases.input: invoice number INV-88213 total shows ₹4,999 but my bank statement shows ₹5,499 deducted, please explain the ₹500 difference
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer flags a ₹500 discrepancy between the invoice total and the amount deducted from their bank statement.
test_cases.notes: Numeric precision test — summary must not drop or alter the specific figures.

test_cases.input: The export feature works fine for CSV but silently fails for PDF — no error message, just nothing happens.
test_cases.expected_summary: PDF export silently fails with no error message, while CSV export works correctly.
test_cases.notes: Tests that the model captures the specific-format-only nature of the bug.

test_cases.input: I run a small nonprofit — do you offer discounted or free plans for registered nonprofits?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether discounted or free plans are available for nonprofits.

test_cases.input: None of my saved filters are showing up anymore, they all just vanished after I logged in today.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer's saved filters have disappeared after logging in today.

test_cases.input: y'all charging me or wat idk my bank app just showed some random deduction
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer noticed an unexplained deduction on their bank app and is unsure if it's from this company.
test_cases.notes: Heavy informal spelling/typos — tests robustness to non-standard text.

test_cases.input: Can you clarify your data retention policy? I need this for a compliance audit at my company.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer needs clarification on the data retention policy for a compliance audit.
test_cases.notes: Could brush against account (data) but is a policy/info request, not an account action.

test_cases.input: I upgraded my plan an hour ago but I still don't have access to the premium features I paid for.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer upgraded their plan an hour ago but still lacks access to the paid premium features.
test_cases.notes: Overlaps billing (payment) and technical (feature access) — labeled billing since root cause is the plan upgrade not propagating, a billing-system issue.

test_cases.input: Every time I click 'save' on the settings page, it just spins forever and never actually saves.
test_cases.expected_summary: The settings page save button spins indefinitely and never completes saving.

test_cases.input: I need to transfer ownership of our team workspace to a new admin since I'm leaving the company.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer needs to transfer workspace ownership to a new admin due to leaving the company.

test_cases.input: Just wanted to check — is customer support available on weekends too?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether support is available on weekends.
